description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ModelTrait' that provides serialization functionalities for models, including setting filters, attribute names, and converting an entity to an array with nested collection handling.

methods.name: setFilters
methods.description: Sets the filter array which determines which attributes to include during serialization.

methods.name: setAttributeNames
methods.description: Overrides attribute names for the model during serialization.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity object to be serialized.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the entity to an array based on set filters and attribute names, supporting nested attributes and collections.

methods.name: makeNestedArray
methods.description: Helper function to create nested arrays from keys and a value.

methods.name: normalizeNestedCollection
methods.description: Normalizes a collection of objects into an array of associative arrays based on specified getter methods.
